stacker.calibration: none additional; calibrated branch probabilities feed logistic likelihood
stacker.threshold: maximize balanced accuracy on meta-cross-fitted outer-training predictions; 0.01..0.99, tie nearest0.5

nested_branch_OOF: For each frozen inner validation fold, repeat frozen branch selection/calibration/refit within its inner training set using four new recording-disjoint subfolds. No inner assessment label enters its branch fit or calibration.

gate.positive_complementarity: RT-DETR rescues sensor failure errors in >=5 recordings; lower95 clustered CI for failure rescue fraction >0
gate.conditional: complementarity present but any incremental-evidence requirement unresolved
gate.no_go: no meaningful complementarity, or upper95 AP gain <=0.01 while estimated AP gain<=0; material contradictory AUROC loss also prevents GO

limitations: Same cohort/folds previously inspected in Section1; this is an adaptive follow-up, not independent confirmatory evidence. Oracle is descriptive and nondeployable.
